summary: With Abandoned, But Not Forgotten, we wanted to give a voice to the machines left behind on the Moon and Mars, allowing them to tell their own stories to anyone fascinated by space exploration. Our project addresses the NASA Space Apps storytelling challenge by combining NASA mission history and scientific discoveries with creative storytelling, animation and engaging visuals. Through the personal journeys of the three Apollo Lunar Rovers and Sojourner, we explore their achievements, the reasons they were left behind and their lasting impact on space exploration. By turning forgotten equipment into explorers with stories to tell, we make space science more engaging, understandable and memorable, while reminding audiences that even when a mission ends, its discoveries continue to shape humanity's journey into the unknown.
details: A five-act digital storytelling experience narrated by the machines left behind on the Moon and Mars. Through the voices of the Apollo 15, 16 and 17 Lunar Rovers and NASA's Sojourner rover, the story brings their historic journeys to life, from exploring distant landscapes to making discoveries that shaped future missions. It moves from the history of lunar exploration to Sojourner's remarkable journey on Mars, before revealing why these machines were left behind and how their legacy continues through modern space technology. Blending NASA mission history, personal narration and visual storytelling, the project transforms forgotten space equipment into explorers with stories still worth telling.
